notes.title: Update Notes for April 16th Update
notes.content:
Fixed our issue with the Leaderboard that is accessible from the Main Menu when clicking the Profile button.

A few weeks ago we changed the end game scores to only show the last game played. We then created a new leaderboard that only showed the three leaderboards:
Total Wins
Wins Per Day
Wins Per Month

We then made a few changes to the end game scored that broke the leaderboards, so todays fixed should resolve all Leaderboard issues.

Please let me know if you have any issues and we can look at fixing them. 

Thanks!

Arcane Warriors

notes.title: Thanks to our community: We're featured in AAPI in Gaming + Patch Magazine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280439/9be58e9ea0177725ba29bbe82d3b170d8977d07a.png[/img]

Our release date is finally here! Thank you so much for counting down with us on social media as we celebrated this major milestone for our tiny team: For most of us it was our first ever Steam release!

We've been so overwhelmed by the support in the community, whether it's from friends and family, our playtester community, and now our new additions to the flock: AAPI in Gaming + Patch Magazine.

AAPI in Gaming featured us on multiple social media platforms and did a deep dive carousel into our dev story. We're super proud to have half our dev team be a part of the AAPI community as well as getting a chance to meet the AAPI in Gaming staff and community in person in San Francisco this past GDC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280439/0cc60554e737f023a85c44e4fc3bfbb307635a51.png[/img]

In addition, Patch Magazine featured us in a roundup alongside other *INCREDIBLE* bird indie games. If you haven't played Keywe (Fireshine Games), Flock (Hollow Ponds + Annapurna), Death's Door (Acid Nerve + Devolver Digital), Star Birds (Toukana Interactive), A Short Hike (adamgryu), and of course, Untitled Goose Game (House House + Panic, Inc.), stop what you're doing, (buy Trinkets! first) and play one of these unforgettable titles!! Also, wishlist Call of Boba (Tomatoast) and Rooster (Sticky Brain Studios) if you haven't already!!

With any release, there will always be some bumps in the road: We're working to make our leaderboard compatible with Steam so we've temporarily taken down that feature. Keep watching this space for more updates on when we get the leaderboard up and running!

In the mean time, if you have additional questions, encounter bugs, or just want to say hey and/or congrats, we'll be available here or via email (the.arcane.warriors@gmail.com) to help answer any questions you may have.

notes.title: Coming Soon: Trinkets! Full Game Update
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye!

Peasants, gentry, and royalty alike: We're so excited to shake up your 21st century friends and foes' gatherings with a sparring experience unlike anything you've seen before. After being awarded the Most Innovative award this past fall from judges at Akupara Games, Xsolla, NetEase, and more, we've been hard at work behind the scenes to bring you the indie title that's sure to make your next party a bit more jester-friendly. Scroll on to read more about what you can expect from our full game!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280439/3a67b5ece135cd77029b9449dd29524dd021e7c2.png[/img]

[b]1) TWO! new actions: Random + Swap[/b]

In rounds 1-4, players will use a brand new sabotage: Random! This sabotage allows a player to exchange a trinket on the board with a random trinket from the pool. We hope that players use this to both refresh their trinket options if their secret category isn't onscreen as well as to begin to make guesses on what categories their opponents may have on hand. 

In rounds 5-8, players will use another brand new sabotage: Swap! This sabotage allows a player to swap the position of two trinkets. Important note here: your sabotage will take place after the round ends but before your trinket gets added to your chest. "Rats! I wanted the green weapon but now I'm stuck with a blue gem! There go my points." - your opponents, probably.

Demo players will be familiar with our egg bomb that's here to stay. This feature allows you to destroy one trinket of choice. New to the full game: You will now have *two* egg bombs in one of our new set of rules we're debuting. We'll be dedicating an entire future blog post update on these new rules specifically but you can expect two different sets of rules to keep your opponents on their toes!

[b]2) Private lobbies[/b]

Don't want strangers lurking in the castle corners plotting your demise? In our full game, you'll have the option to host a private lobby.

[b]3) Crows with even MORE personality[/b]

While choosing a bard crow versus a jester crow doesn't affect the points system, you can now expect the crows to be even squawkier than ever. We're debuting new lines of egg-celent trash talking to create an even more immersive gameplay experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280439/9d99f16f66b7e400735ae280154b5713f3fef3d2.png[/img]

[b]4) Refreshed UI + UX and tutorial [/b]

The castle's looking a lot shinier these days! Our UX team has been hard at work making the castle more intuitive. In addition, our updated tutorial features tips and tricks on how to more consistently get higher scores and get better at deducing your opponents' categories. 

[b]5) More detailed scoreboard[/b]

Wanted to improve your gameplay but didn't know where exactly your strategy went wrong? We're debuting a more in-depth win/lose scoreboard that will help you level up and sabotage even better the next time the call of Trinkets! beckons you in.

--

Thank you so much for your continued interest in Trinkets! and your support this past week at Steam Next Fest! We were able to double our wishlists and wanted to thank you all for being a part of our growing crow-mmunity.

By order of our developer team, we've decreed that there shall be a future [b]full game release date announcement[/b] and more exciting updates from us in 2025 and beyond!
